name: OpenSignup
description: Sign-up sheets for snack rotations, volunteer shifts and carpools.

paths.name: Data
paths.description: The database (postgres/), the mail viewer's emails (mail/) and the secrets made on first start (state/). Back up the whole folder.

ports.name: Web UI
ports.description: OpenSignup and its mail viewer (/mail), published on host as 6727

variables.name: TZ
variables.description: Your time zone, like Europe/London or America/New_York.

variables.name: PUBLIC_URL
variables.description: Required. Replace YOUR-SERVER-IP with your server IP, like http://192.168.1.20:6727. Sign-in links, share links and the links in emails use this address. Behind HTTPS with your own domain, set it to that address, like https://signup.example.com.
